## Finding Your Purchase Details

<https://docs.wpuserregistration.com/account-license/finding-your-purchase-details>

Find Your Purchase Details | User Registration & Membership

# Finding Your Purchase Details
Access your purchase history, invoice details, and download receipts from your account dashboard using your registered email address.
Last updated on Jul 14, 2026

If you have to look for the purchase details of the product you have purchased, log in to https://wpeverest.com/my-account/ using the email address you have used while purchasing.

Now, you will be redirected to your account dashboard. On the **Dashboard**, the first tab is for **Purchase Details**.

## This tab consists of the following details.

**ID:** This is the invoice ID of the purchase.

**Date**: The date when the purchase was made.

**Amount:** Cost of the plan you have purchased.

**Invoice:** You can check the invoice details from here. You can also print or download the PDF of the invoice.

## Cancel Subscription

<https://docs.wpuserregistration.com/account-license/how-to-cancel-my-subscription>

Cancel Plugin Subscription | User Registration & Membership

# Cancel Subscription
Step-by-step guide to canceling your plugin subscription, including information about automatic renewals, reminder emails, and accessing subscription settings in your account.
Last updated on Jul 14, 2026

By default all our plugins are subscription based. Once purchased you will be automatically charged for the next year on the discounted price as per mentioned in the plugin pricing page.

However, before charging for the renewal we do send you a reminder email one a month before the renewal data and another a week ago.

If you wish to cancel your subscription and no longer want to continue with the product then you can simply follow the steps.

First login to your account page with the email and password you setup during the purchase of the product.

Once logged in simply visit the **Subscription** Tab on your account page. You will find all the previous payment details.

Simply click on the **Cancel** Button on the currently active subscription.

A popup will appear to confirm that you wish to proceed with the cancellation. Simply click the** Cancel Anyway** button and your subscription will be cancelled.

After canceling the subscription, a ‘**Cancelled**‘ notice will appear next to the plan name.

Purchase Invoice for User Registration & Membership Docs

# Generate Purchase Invoice
Learn how to access, view, and download invoices for your WPEverest plugin purchases through your account dashboard.
Last updated on Jul 14, 2026

In this tutorial, you’ll learn how to generate an invoice for your purchase of WPEverest plugins in three easy steps.

## **Step 1: Log in to wpeverest.com **

First of all, make sure are logged in to your WPEverest account. If you aren’t logged in yet, you can log in here .

## **Step 2: Click on the Purchase History tab**

After you’re logged in, go to the **My Account** page and you can see the My Account tabs: Purchase History, Profile, License Keys, Subscriptions and Downloads.

Now, Click on the **Purchase History** tab in the Dashboard and you can see all of your purchase records are listed here.

## **Step 3: Click on View Invoice**

To view the invoice for any of your purchases, you need to click on **View Invoice** Button.

## **Step 4:Download Generated Invoice**

To download the invoice for any of your purchases, you need to click on **Download PDF.**

## **Step 5: Update Invoice**

To make changes to the invoice for any of your purchases, click the “Update” button and then proceed to make the required adjustments

## Manage Site License

<https://docs.wpuserregistration.com/account-license/how-to-manage-your-site-licenses>

Manage Site License Keys | User Registration & Membership

# Manage Site License
Learn how to view, activate, and deactivate WPEverest plugin license keys across multiple sites through your account dashboard.
Last updated on Jul 14, 2026

After you purchase our pro plugin, you can manage your site license keys effortlessly through your WPEverest account dashboard.

This guide will walk you through viewing active sites, deactivating licenses, and managing your activations.

## Accessing Your License Keys

Log in to WPEverest at https://wpeverest.com/login/

You will be redirected to your account page at https://wpeverest.com/my-account/

Navigate to the License Keys tab

On this page, you can view:

Your pro plans

Activation keys for each plan

Number of sites currently using each activation key

## Managing Active Sites

In the License Keys tab, locate the license you want to manage

Click the Manage Sites button next to your license key

A new window will appear showing all sites currently using that license key

From this window, you can:

View which sites are actively using your license

See how many activation slots are being used based on your pro plan

Deactivate sites whenever needed by clicking the deactivation option

## Activating a Site License

To activate the pro version on a new site, you'll need to enter your license key in the plugin settings on that WordPress installation.

For detailed instructions on activating User Registration Pro on a site, refer to the license verification documentation: https://docs.wpeverest.com/user-registration/homepage/how-to-verify-license-key-for-premium-addons/

## Important Notes

The number of sites you can activate depends on your purchased pro plan

You can deactivate sites at any time to free up activation slots

Deactivating a site does not delete your license, you can reactivate it later

Site deactivation is useful when moving from staging to production or switching domains

## Renew a Subscription Manually

<https://docs.wpuserregistration.com/account-license/how-to-renew-a-subscription-manually>

Manually Renew Your Subscription - Step-by-Step Guide

# Renew a Subscription Manually
Step-by-step instructions for manually renewing a canceled subscription through your account dashboard, from login to payment completion.
Last updated on Jul 14, 2026

If you have canceled auto-renewal for your subscription and need to renew it manually, you can do so directly from your account dashboard. This guide walks you through the manual renewal process.

## Steps to Renew Your Subscription Manually

### Step 1: Access Your Account

Log in to your account page using your credentials.

### Step 2: Navigate to Subscriptions

Once logged in, go to Dashboard → Subscription tab

Locate your subscription in the list

In the Action column, click the Renew License link

### Step 3: Complete the Checkout

You will be redirected to the checkout page

Click the Buy Now button

### Step 4: Enter Payment Details

A payment popup will appear

Enter your payment details in the form

Click Pay to complete the renewal

## What Happens Next

After successful payment, your subscription will be renewed and you'll regain access to all premium features and updates associated with your plan.

## Update Billing Details for WPEverest Purchase

<https://docs.wpuserregistration.com/account-license/how-to-update-billing-details-for-wpeverest-purchase>

Update Billing Details for WPEverest Purchase

# Update Billing Details for WPEverest Purchase
Step-by-step guide to update payment methods, billing information, and manage saved cards for WPEverest subscriptions through FastSpring.
Last updated on Jul 14, 2026

To change your billing details and cards associated with the purchase.

Login to your account page

Once you are on your account page. Visit the **Subscriptions** tab.

Click on **Update Payment Method**

You will be redirected to our payment gateway page where you are asked to enter the email address associated with the purchase order. Enter the email address and click **continue**.

You will receive an email with a login link. Simply check your inbox, open the email and click the link “**Click here to manage your orders**“

You will automatically be logged into the orders page of FastSpring. Click on the **Account Details **tab. If you want to add a new payment method then click on “**Add Payment Method**." You can also change the profile details if you want.

### **Manage Your Saved Cards in FastSpring**

You can easily **add or remove cards** associated with your FastSpring account by following these steps:

**Access Your Account**

Visit FastSpring Account .

Enter the **email address associated with your account**.

A login link will be sent to your email. Click the link to access your FastSpring Dashboard.

**Navigate to Account Details**

Once logged in, go to **Account Details**.

You will see a **list of cards** you have previously added.

**Manage Your Cards**

Click **Manage** next to the card you want to update.

You have two options:

**Make Default** – Set this card as your primary payment method.

**Remove Card** – Delete the card from your account.

**Visual Reference**

Please refer to the attached screenshot for guidance on where to find the Manage option and how to perform these actions.

## Upgrade License Plan

<https://docs.wpuserregistration.com/account-license/how-to-upgrade-your-license-plan>

Upgrade License Plan | User Registration & Membership

# Upgrade License Plan
Learn how to upgrade your plugin license to a higher plan at a prorated price through your account's License Keys section.
Last updated on Jul 17, 2026

If you have purchased any one of our lower plugin plans like Personal Plan and would like to upgrade to Profession Plan or any other higher plan in order to unlock other awesome features and addons, then it’s quite easy.

**All the upgrades can be done at a prorated price, i.e. you only pay the amount difference between the plans.**

For this please log in via https://wpeverest.com/login/ and you will be redirected to your account page https://wpeverest.com/my-account/

Once you are on your account page, go to the **License Keys** Tab. Here you will see the plan you have already purchased. If there are upgrades available then you will see the View Upgrades link. Click on the View Upgrades link and it will list all the available upgrades and their corresponding pro-rated price.

Click on the **View Upgrades** button beside the plan you wish to upgrade to. And you will be redirected to the checkout page. Fill in the payment details and complete the purchase. Congratulations, you have successfully upgraded your plan at pro-rated pricing.
